-The `qwikRouterConfig.routes` property is used to retrieve the route list of your application.
+Qwik Router generates the route config of your application at build time. Read it through these functions, which every copy of the router in the process shares:
+- `getRouterConfig()` resolves the whole config, with the route trie and the server plugins.
+- `getBasePathname()` returns the base pathname the app is served under, such as `/`.
+- `getTrailingSlash()` returns whether the app's URLs end with a slash.
+A production server build leaves out the pages it prerendered without server code, so its route trie only holds the routes the server still serves.
+The `@qwik-router-config` virtual module still exports the same values for existing code, but it only resolves inside the app build.

The `useQwikRouter()` function is used to initialize Qwik Router in the existing document, providing the necessary context for Qwik Router to work, such as [`useContent()`](/docs/(qwikrouter)/api/index.mdx#usecontent), `useLocation()` and `<RouterOutlet />`.
